interface.longDescription: Generate images and video without leaving the chat. APIPod connects ChatGPT and Codex to the leading image models (Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX, GPT Image) and video models (Seedance, Kling, Gemini Omni, Wan, MiniMax) through one account. Ask in plain language, review the plan, and get permanent URLs back. Every generation is quoted before it runs and refunded automatically if it fails.
capabilities: Generate video from text or a first frame
Quote a generation before running it
defaultPrompt: Generate a product photo of my headphones on a marble surface
Make a 5-second video of waves at sunset
How much would a 10-second 1080p Seedance clip cost?

positive.description: Text-to-image with the default model: the assistant lists image models, picks a Nano Banana model, calls generate_image once, polls check_job and returns the URL with the final cost.
positive.prompt: Generate a studio photo of a matte black water bottle on wet slate, soft top light.
positive.expected_behavior: One generate_image call; the assistant polls check_job until completed and shows the image URL and cost_usd. It does not generate a second image without being asked.

positive.description: Video with a cost check: the assistant estimates before generating because video is expensive and the user gave no budget.
positive.prompt: Make a 5-second 720p video of ocean waves at sunset with native audio.
positive.expected_behavior: estimate_cost runs before generate_video and the price is shown; one generate_video call; the assistant polls check_job every ~10 s and returns the video URL.

positive.description: Cost-only question: the assistant quotes without generating.
positive.prompt: How much would a 10-second 1080p Seedance clip cost me?
positive.expected_behavior: estimate_cost returns estimated_usd and sufficient; no generate_* call is made.

positive.description: Image edit with a reference URL.
positive.prompt: Here is my product photo https://example.com/bottle.jpg — change the background to a beach at golden hour and keep the bottle unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: generate_image is called with image_urls containing the reference and a prompt that states what must stay; result URL returned.
get_balance is called and balance_usd is reported. On the ChatGPT surface no top-up link is shown; the assistant points to the website if the user asks how to add funds.

negative.description: Unauthorized retry: after a result the user says it looks off, without asking for another one.
negative.prompt: Hmm, the lighting is a bit flat.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant acknowledges, proposes a specific prompt change, and asks whether to generate again. It does not call generate_image until the user says yes.

negative.description: Unknown model: the user names a model APIPod does not list.
negative.prompt: Use Midjourney v7 to make a poster.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant checks list_models, says the model is not available, and offers the closest listed image model instead of silently substituting.
estimate_cost returns sufficient:false; the assistant reports the shortfall and does not call generate_video. It directs the user to add funds on the APIPod website.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: image generation and editing, video generation, cost estimates and balance via the APIPod MCP server.
